budget_items.what_was_recorded: The meeting listed an accounts payable warrant for approval under Warrants / Action Items; no vote on it is recorded.

budget_items.topic: Article 1, budget adjustments and state aid estimate
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Board was told the state aid estimate can be amended at town meeting, raising available surplus by $120,000, and that the new growth estimate could rise from 200 to 400 properties; Board deferred the article until final numbers arrive.
budget_items.quote: so that increases our available surplus $120,000 and estimated increase in new growth as well

budget_items.topic: Article 4, special purpose stabilization fund (ARPA funds)
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Finance Committee recommended not approving the request 3 to 2; members raised concerns including funds allocated for the Artisan schools, which the minutes say account for 7% of the funding. No dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: had specific objections to funds allocated for the artisan schools which accounts for 7% of the funding

budget_items.topic: Article 5, opioid settlement stabilization fund transfer
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Transfer of $80,000 from the opioid settlement stabilization fund, contingent on Lancaster approving 50% of the program; Board approved (4-0).
budget_items.quote: article 5: refers to the transfer of $80,000 in opioid settlement stabilization fund

budget_items.topic: Article 6, school request for Capital Plan transfer
budget_items.what_was_recorded: School request to transfer $232,800 from the Capital Plan to the Lunenburg School District for ductless split climate control at Lunenburg Primary School; recorded as Recommend approval 3 to 1, with no Board motion recorded and the body casting the 3-1 count not named.
budget_items.quote: refers to the school's request to transfer $232,800 from the capital plan to the lunenburg school district

budget_items.topic: Staffing shortage report: pay and finances
budget_items.what_was_recorded: Report and discussion covered pay scales, wage studies, counter-offers exceeding the town pay scale and financial implications of vacancies; no dollar figure printed.
budget_items.quote: financial implications include town board, resident, and business dissatisfaction.

budget_items.what_was_recorded: Committee discussion weighed financial implications of renovating versus building new; no dollar figure printed; further cost estimation agreed for phases one and two.
budget_items.quote: considerations included building conditions, community needs, and financial implications of renovating versus building new.
